The UK is banning smoking. What do you think?


BBC News (UK) (@BBCNews)

Smoking ban for people born after 2008 in the UK agreed bbc.in/4cEfrbq




— https://nitter.net/BBCNews/status/2046527683731828847#m
Some people lived through 2020-2022 and concluded that the government needs more taxpayer money and more power.

You can lift people up without tearing other people down.

I wish this simple concept was better understood.
It's funny how simply being a normal human being is now labeled as 'right wing' or 'trad'.

I've never had this thought in my life. Not once.


Hispanic Nomad | Remote Work, Travel, Growth (@hispanicnomad)

Being bald sucks. You literally become “the bald guy” and it’s all people see

No reason not to spend a bit of money to fix it







— https://nitter.net/hispanicnomad/status/2046247282245550461#m
I'm amused by people who think blocking an account on social media equates to censorship or a violation of freedom of speech.
The Book of Proverbs is SO good. Timeless wisdom.

I am actually on track... 😲


ZUBY: (@ZubyMusic)

I just want to be a location independent multi-millionaire with a beautiful wife, 5+ kids, millions of adoring fans all over the world, and a clear conscience. 

Perfectly reasonable and achievable. 😃



— https://nitter.net/ZubyMusic/status/1400208640003514377#m

Also, the leading cause of death amongst young men in the UK is suicide.

Frankly, I think men have collectively been torn down enough and could do with some encouragement.

It's rough out there.


BBC News (UK) (@BBCNews)

One in three young men now live with their parents, ONS data shows bbc.in/4sHRJ47




— https://nitter.net/BBCNews/status/2045424931542855851#m

The UK is a beautiful country that has fallen from its former glory. It has been declining for decades due to a complex mix of economic, cultural, and political factors.

It's a bad place to be ambitious. But if you're not, then it's ok I guess.


Kunn (@Kunnoyl)

what's wrong with the UK?



— https://nitter.net/Kunnoyl/status/2045548671555788949#m

I wish I took the orange pill this early too!


ZUBY: (@ZubyMusic)

I took the #RedPill a few years ago. Nothing has been the same ever since. It's bittersweet...



— https://nitter.net/ZubyMusic/status/431872124613971969#m

Imagine posting that 'Dubai is done' whilst living in the UK.

SMH.


Ray (@Tee_Osman_)

Dubai done. Those who’ve heavily invested are parrots repeating the same shit, only to make themselves feel better.



— https://nitter.net/Tee_Osman_/status/2045542851874902388#m
